checks: Courier routes and all six stop pairs use existing clear streets; vehicle footprint and alighting points checked against static colliders.
Food: insufficient funds/no route, duplicate confirmations, cancellation/refund in every pre-handover stage, physical receipt, stored consumption and reload without duplicate money or meals.

Rides: all stop pairs, no boarding from a distance/interior, continuous travel, reload during dispatch/wait/travel/arrival, once-only fare, pre-boarding refunds and physical early drop-off without refund.
Legacy simmer migrates to the physical kitchen without double ingredient deduction; new recipe actions covered by check:physical-home.
Legacy saves migrate without resets; invalid service state and full meal storage are rejected.
scope: Automated domain/state and static-route checks, not browser/device verification
